serverInfo.name: @guardbee/mcp-oauth-auditor
serverInfo.description: MCP server that scans an MCP server's own authorization code for OAuth 2.1 anti-patterns named in the MCP spec's Security Considerations: token passthrough, missing audience validation, OAuth/OIDC discovery SSRF, missing PKCE, loose redirect_uri validation, and hardcoded client secrets

tools.name: scan_text
tools.description: Scan an MCP server's authorization code for OAuth 2.1 anti-patterns: token passthrough, missing audience validation, OAuth/OIDC discovery SSRF, missing PKCE, loose redirect_uri validation, and hardcoded client secrets.

label.description: Optional label shown in findings (e.g. filename)

tools.name: scan_file
tools.description: Scan a single file for OAuth/token-handling anti-patterns

path.description: Absolute or relative path to the file to scan

tools.name: scan_directory
tools.description: Recursively scan a directory of MCP server source for OAuth/token-handling anti-patterns

path.description: Absolute or relative path to the directory to scan

maxFiles.description: Maximum number of files to scan (default: 5000)

include.description: Only scan files whose path contains one of these strings

exclude.description: Skip files/dirs whose path contains one of these strings

tools.name: list_patterns
tools.description: List every OAuth/token-handling pattern this auditor detects, grouped by category
